data.text: Welcome, Luke. My family taught me to fish here, and I want this lake to keep supporting our village. I’d support a 10-ton limit each this month—that’s $10,000 apiece without shrinking next month’s stock. If someone wants to sell you part of their allowance, let’s agree on the transfer openly beforehand so it doesn’t become extra catch. We can review everyone’s catches together each month. John, does that work for you?
